description: A fictional static App Router site for migrate v0 (D-101): a root layout with a title template, description, global stylesheet, and an Astro-convertible header component; static pages with next/link, page metadata, a dropped segment option, a route group, a nested layout, a static Preact component with an early return, a relocated library module whose type-only aliased import is rewritten, and public assets. A test file is preserved as out of scope. A dynamic route without generateStaticParams and a client page are preserved. The manifest names the real next package, so the harness creates it at test time (Q-014).
